idea-plugin.name: FairyGUI Preview
idea-plugin.description:
Live visual preview of FairyGUI component XML files, next to the XML editor.

  • Editor / Split / Preview toggle, like the Markdown preview. The preview follows unsaved edits as you type.
  • Renders nested components, images (9-slice, tile, tint, flip), text, graphs, loaders, lists, groups, Label / Button / ProgressBar overrides, gears and relations.
  • Switch the component's controller pages and preview on the project's device resolutions.
  • Click an element to jump to it in the XML; moving the caret highlights the element in the preview; double-click a nested component to open its file.
  • Diffs of a component (Git log, local changes, compare with branch) offer a "FairyGUI preview" viewer: both revisions side by side with added, removed and changed elements marked.

Works on any FairyGUI editor project (a folder with a .fairy file and an assets folder). Everything runs locally in the IDE's embedded browser.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.2.0

  • Files added in a pull request (or otherwise missing from the working copy) now get the "FairyGUI preview" diff viewer.
  • Less memory: a preview hidden for a minute releases its embedded browser and comes back with the same zoom, controller pages and options; canvases and image data are freed as soon as a render replaces them.

1.1.0

  • Diff viewer: "FairyGUI preview" in the diff window shows both revisions side by side and marks added, removed and changed elements.
  • Layout matches the FairyGUI editor much more closely: relations now follow FairyGUI's own event order (pivots, centre/right edges kept on resize, percent and ext types, groups, component-level relations), auto-sized text is measured with the project font, controller actions and specific home pages are applied, and gears on Label/Button instances drive their title.

1.0.0

  • First release.
